material_findings.title: MemSentry adds a persistent-memory write-policy research lead
material_findings.summary: arXiv:2609.08747 proposes a configuration-driven gate for persistent-memory writes that emits Accept, Review, or Quarantine decisions based on source trust, semantic risk, dependency-graph attack radius, access risk, and signed security-state change.
material_findings.evidence_boundary: The authors report evaluation over 1,000 GPT-4-generated scenarios, with SBERT+LR at 91.7% accuracy and 0.908 macro-F1 and all four compared classifiers detecting 100% of external quarantine-class threats. These are unreproduced preprint claims and should not be converted into a repository security guarantee.
material_findings.repository_fit: The design is directly relevant to this repository's existing external-agent contribution, provenance, authorization, and persistent-state boundaries. It may complement the already-preserved authorization-laundering and CONTINUITY research leads.
material_findings.recommended_action: Build/Integrity should review the decision model and assumptions, then create deterministic benign memory-write fixtures that compare source trust, security-state weakening, dependency impact, and human-review escalation. Import no code or dependency until an official artifact/license is established and results are independently reproduced.
